snippet.title: Official Trailer | Airport Baggage Simulator
snippet.description:
Step into the chaos of airport security in Airport Baggage Simulator! 🧳✈️

Scan luggage, detect suspicious items, sort overweight monster trolleys, and build your own conveyor belt system. Start with manual checks and evolve into full automation as you expand your airport and unlock new destinations.

Think sorting baggage sounds easy? Think again.

🎮 Play the demo & check it out on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3887090/Airport_Baggage_Simulator/

👉 Wishlist now and don’t miss takeoff!

#demo #steamgame #newgame #steamnextfest #playnow
